about: Astro originals for ported components (tools/visual.mjs reference check): each WASM variant (comp + variant label) against an element of a docs explorer item (components/#<item>, the index-th match of selector, default '.explorer__preview .ex-prev'), captured headless in both themes at 720 into tests/ref/ (kept in the repo: the Astro originals are frozen). astro.static = a capture made by hand (an Astro part with no explorer item), never re-captured. ssim / iou = per-reference thresholds (default 0.8 / 0.6; SSIM on luminance with the background taken away); under them = flagged for review, never a failure. crop = compare the ink boxes only (both cropped to their ink, the docs one scaled to the WASM one): for whole-component references whose stage padding differs.
